projection: tile (col,row) top corner = ((col-row)*16, (col+row)*8); col runs east (screen right-down), row runs south (screen left-down)

groundKey.grass: tiles.grass (mix plain/tall/flowers; tall+flowers use the -sway sheets)
groundKey.water: tiles.water (pick 1 of 4 variants per tile; overlays by the manifest rule)

notes: objects sit with their manifest anchor (footprint top corner) on the top corner of tile (col,row). Depth-sort objects and characters by the screen y of the footprint front corner, i.e. (col+A + row+B)*8. Lamps are lamp-off by day; the day/night cycle swaps them to lamp-on with fx-lamp-glow. The arena's gate (12,32)-(13,32) is blocked until arena fights exist; unblock it to open the sand floor. The bridge (bridge: tiles over the river at the east road's end) is drawn by the game; gates.hood: walking onto these tiles goes to the neighbourhood (the arrow sign at (68,33) points there). arrive.hood: where you appear coming back from the neighbourhood (the east road's end, before the bridge). spawn: in front of the plaza fountain (members with a house start at their door in the neighbourhood instead).
treeGrounding: Every standing tree has a shadow and tufts. Draw the shadow on the ground layer, centred on the trunk tile centre shifted (+5,+1) px (mirror the x shift when flip is true). Draw the tufts strip right after the tree at the trunk tile centre offset (-10,-5). Objects with "flip": true are drawn mirrored left-to-right (anchor x becomes width - anchor x). groundStyle: "lush" grass uses 55% tall grass, 15% flowers, 30% plain; "litter" uses tiles/tile-grass-litter-1/2 (darker grass with fallen leaves) under thick groves.

outskirts.note: The forest around the town (world/outskirts.ts), generated (seeded) for whatever the camera can see past the map; not walkable. ground/meadow = grass mixes (tiles.grass.mixes) for the forest floor and for the strips within clear tiles of an edge, which stay free of trees (wider on the river sides, so no tree stands between the camera and a player by the river). water = [col0, row0, col1, row1] rectangles where the river runs on outside the map. trees = tree prop -> its shadow; treeChance per 2x2 cell; undergrowth props per tile.
